messages:
kai: Dry-run blocked for tonight's eu-west promotion. Helm failed merging overlays/edgezone: prometheus.scrape.targets changed shape (array vs map). Can someone own a mitigation? cc @lena

lena: On it. Paste the CI error?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: DRY-RUN FAILED
service metrics-sidecar: helm template failed while applying overlays/edgezone.yaml
Command: helm upgrade --install metrics-sidecar ./charts/metrics-sidecar --dry-run --values values/eu.yaml --values overlays/edgezone.yaml
Error: conflicting types for key 'prometheus.scrape.targets' (expected list, got map)
See logs: http://ci.internal/DRY-67890

kai: Overlay added a map keyed by job name to try to dedupe targets, upstream chart still expects array of objects. Auto-merge would break scraping.

lena: Short-term: safest is to pin metrics-sidecar chart to 0.8.4 and run a small canary. We'll schedule a hotpatch to migrate overlay to array-of-objects and add a CI shape check.

infra-oncall: I'm available. Pin + canary sounds good for the change window. If canary shows scrape regressions we reclaim traffic and rollback.

ops-bot: k8s: recommend canary with 3 replicas (same as upstream canary) and increased probe timeout because scrape startup can be slow. Also set surge to avoid OOMs.

lena: I'll open a quick PR to pin the chartVersion in overlays/edgezone/kustomization.yaml and add a one-line note about follow-up work. Commands:
```
# pin chart version
git checkout -b fix/edgezone-metrics-pin
yq e '.resources[0].chartVersion = "0.8.4"' -i overlays/edgezone/kustomization.yaml
git add overlays/edgezone/kustomization.yaml && git commit -m "pin metrics-sidecar to 0.8.4 to avoid prometheus.targets shape mismatch" && git push origin fix/edgezone-metrics-pin
```
I'll request review from @kai.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR merged. Starting canary metrics-sidecar@0.8.4 at 5% traffic. Canary job id METR-678.

ops-bot: k8s: canary started. metrics-eu-canary x3 pods. Ready 3/3. Observing scrapes and exporter metrics.

kai: Drafting release note: - pinned metrics-sidecar chart to 0.8.4 due to prometheus.scrape.targets shape mismatch in edgezone overlay - follow-up hotpatch to convert overlay to array-of-objects and add CI shape validation

ops-bot: canary metrics @12m: exporter scrape success rate 100%, p50 scrape latency +10ms. No missing targets.

lena: Bumping to 25% after 20m stable. deploy-bot: route-canary METR-678 set-traffic 25%

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: traffic updated to 25% for METR-678.

ops-bot: 25% at 15m: scrape metrics stable, no drop in target count. CPU at 45% of request.

infra-oncall: If anything drops in the next 10m, we abort and rollback. Keep updates here.

kai: If stable for 30m at 25% we promote. No objections so far.

lena: Promoting to 100% now. deploy-bot: promote METR-678

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promoted canary METR-678 to stable metrics-sidecar@0.8.4. Notifying release-notes-bot.

release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: Added entry 2024-12-21: 'Pinned metrics-sidecar chart to 0.8.4 to avoid prometheus.scrape.targets shape mismatch in edgezone overlay; migration hotpatch planned.'

ops-bot: prod rollout complete. metrics-sidecar pods ready 6/6. No alerts.

lena: Follow-up: I'll open a migration PR that converts the overlay map into an array-of-objects and add a CI check (yq + basic type/shape validation) before merges.

kai: Also add a short postmortem note if we see similar pattern across overlays. Thanks all. Closing once release notes link is posted.

release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: https://releases.internal/notes/2024-12-21/metrics-pin
